setup.title: Create the token
setup.description: Check off each step as you go.

classic.open: Open Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Tokens (classic) on GitHub, then Generate new token (classic).
classic.name: Give the token a note naming this Elysium, and choose how long it lasts.
classic.scopes: Select repo, so Elysium can read and write the repositories you use. Add workflow to change GitHub Actions files, and read:org for an organization's repositories.
classic.generate: Generate the token and copy it into Token. GitHub shows it once.

fine-grained.open: Open Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens on GitHub, then Generate new token.
fine-grained.owner: Choose the resource owner, you or an organization, and how long the token lasts.
fine-grained.repositories: Under Repository access, pick the repositories Elysium works in.
fine-grained.permissions: Under Repository permissions, grant Contents read and write, Pull requests read and write, and Metadata read.
fine-grained.generate: Generate the token and copy it into Token. GitHub shows it once.
